items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the thing with Jimi - Jimi was down the street and I heard it.

ctx.x: No, your brother has to attenuate the stuff. So the thing with Jimi - Jimi was down the street and I heard it. Then he went over to England but I heard cause I had played with Howlin’ Wolf and all them cats.
